payload.summary: Found by Jim playing a live game (seed 535986, 2026-08-24). After a question, 'ask' leaves the turn menu — the intended rule is one question per turn — but the full command vocabulary stays typable by design, so typing 'ask' runs it again. Confirmed twice in one turn against Colonel Mustard. doAsk SETS askedOnTurn and never CHECKS it, so the limit is cosmetic. Product question: enforce it in doAsk with a printed refusal, or drop the limit and stop hiding the menu entry. Note the tension with the typable-vocabulary rule (observation ghsv63dr): that rule says the ENGINE owns legality and the UI holds no second copy, but this limit lives only in the UI, which is exactly why it leaks.
